items.claim: CEO says Eaton is on track to deliver full-year and Q4 EPS guidance.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO frames 2026 end-market growth expectation ahead of formal February guidance.
items.quote: we see our 2026 markets growing around 7%.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO gives an incremental margin proxy assumption for modeling 2026 ahead of formal guidance.
items.quote: using a decent incremental 30% would be a good proxy.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states current Electrical Americas margins are already close to 30%.
items.quote: the margins are high, close to 30%. We love it.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO attributes near-term incremental margin pressure in Electrical Americas to simultaneous plant ramp-ups.
items.quote: That creates a number of inefficiencies.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO characterizes the current M&A approach as more focused than the company's historical broad dealmaking.
items.quote: we are a bit more focused this time.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states M&A focus is confined to electrical and aerospace verticals.
items.quote: We said we're going to do electrical and aerospace.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO discloses that a Brazilian competitor was found to be ahead of Eaton in solid-state transformer development, prompting acceleration of Eaton's own program.
items.quote: Brazilian was actually a couple of years ahead of us.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO cites current content-per-megawatt figure in AI data centers under Eaton's existing portfolio.
items.quote: our content per megawatt growing in AI data centers
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO names 3-phase transformer capability as a specific differentiator versus named peers (Vertiv, Schneider).
items.quote: we have 3 phase transformers, they don't.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO says the Boyd acquisition gives Eaton a scale entry into the liquid cooling market.
items.quote: will give us a scale entry into cooling
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states Eaton (via Boyd) is embedded in the next-generation chip development of NVIDIA, Google and Meta.
items.quote: we are embedded in the developments of the NVIDIA
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO discloses the size of the current active negotiation pipeline with customers, mostly data center related.
items.quote: our negotiation pipeline now is around $8 billion
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO acknowledges competitors could eventually attempt to copy Boyd's cold plate engineering.
items.quote: other companies can try to copy and emulate that.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO flags pension moving from a tailwind to a headwind for 2026 below-the-line results.
items.quote: It was a positive guy. It turns into a negative next year.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO flags acquisition financing costs as a below-the-line cost pressure for 2026.
items.quote: those costs will hit the below-the-line item as well.
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO cites Q3 electrical backlog growth versus prior year, split organic vs. Fiberbond acquisition contribution.
items.quote: our backlog is 20% higher than last year
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

items.claim: CEO cites Q3 year-over-year data center order growth rate of 70%.
items.quote: our year-over-year orders in Q3 were up 70%
items.speaker: Paulo Sternadt (CEO)

qa_flags.question: Analyst asked whether Eaton can get back to the prior ~35% incremental margin algorithm in Electrical Americas by this time next year.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO declines to give a specific number, explicitly defers to February guidance instead of confirming or denying the 35% figure ('I don't want to give you guidance. That's February for next year for sure').

qa_flags.question: Analyst pressed directly on whether backlog can continue to build in 2026, reframing it as effectively an orders question.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO does not give a direct yes/no on 2026, says 'it's early to talk about next year' and pivots to historical Q3-over-Q3 backlog growth commentary instead of a forward answer.

qa_flags.question: Analyst asked explicitly whether there are $1 billion-plus orders in the pipeline that could start booking soon.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO does not confirm or deny specific $1B+ orders; instead reframes toward smaller, more frequent $500-700M orders and cites an aggregate $8B negotiation pipeline without isolating any single large order.
